title: Hornero Shell Plugin Manifest
description: Metadata contract for community-authored Hornero Shell extensions (schema versions 1 and 2). Version 2 adds the optional multi-surface `surfaces` map; every version 1 field keeps its meaning. This schema does not define a sandbox or runtime loader, and declared capabilities/surfaces are review metadata, not permission grants or enforcement.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest contract version. 1 = single placement (top-level entrypoint + placement). 2 = same, plus the optional `surfaces` map for extra independently-enabled entry points. Unknown versions are rejected.

surfaces.description: schemaVersion 2 only. Extra entry points, one per surface, each independently enabled (default true). The top-level entrypoint/placement remain the primary surface; redeclaring that surface here is allowed only with the same entrypoint (to set `enabled`) — that cross-field rule is enforced by scripts/validate_plugin.py and the runtime host, not by this structural schema. Hosted today: background, bar, dashboard, desktop. `launcher` and `settings` are validated declarations reserved for their hosts (launcher/search provider, Control Center settings); no host loads them yet and declaring one grants no privilege. A bar surface shows a popover/panel with PluginKit UiPopover; it is not a separate surface.

signing.description: Optional author signature (minisign framing) over the files-only payload hash; verified by horneroctl (trust state 'signed'). Absence is fine: local hash-pinned trust applies instead.

placement.description: Where the primary (top-level) entrypoint runs: background (headless, default), bar (rendered in the bar end group) or dashboard (rendered as a card in the dashboard Extensions tab) or desktop (rendered as a widget on the desktop background layer). In schemaVersion 2, `surfaces` may add entry points on other surfaces; the primary surface stays the placement/entrypoint pair so the v1 meaning is unchanged.

translations.description: Optional per-plugin translations (any schemaVersion). The package ships one flat JSON catalog per declared locale at `<directory>/<locale>.json` (source string -> translated string), each listed in `files`; PluginKit `Translations` loads the catalog matching the shell (system) locale — full tag first, then language — and falls back to the source strings. Catalogs are source-reviewable JSON, never compiled .qm binaries. Cross-field rules (each locale's catalog listed in `files`, catalog well-formedness, coverage of the strings passed to Translations.tr()) are enforced by scripts/validate_plugin.py and the runtime host, not by this structural schema.

sourceLocale.description: Locale tag of the source strings in the package's QML, e.g. "en" or "es_AR". No catalog is needed for it: the strings in code are that locale's text.

locales.description: Locales the package ships a catalog for, as Qt locale tags ("es", "es_AR", "pt_BR").

directory.description: Package-relative directory holding the catalogs. Defaults to "translations".

marketplace.description: Optional marketplace metadata (shell#379, any schemaVersion) the Extensions pane renders WITHOUT executing plugin code: static screenshot images shipped in the package, declared shell compatibility, a short version history, and a deprecation / replaced-by state. It grants no privilege and changes no lifecycle — install, update and rollback stay on the existing horneroctl verified provenance contracts (shell#251/#366). Cross-field rules (screenshot listed in `files`, minShellVersion <= maxShellVersion, replacedBy different from the plugin's own id) are enforced by scripts/validate_plugin.py and mirrored by the runtime host, not by this structural schema.

screenshots.description: Static preview images shipped in `files` and shown as plain images — never QML, SVG or animated formats, so no plugin code runs to render a preview.

compatibility.description: Declared Hornero Shell version range (semantic versions, both bounds inclusive). Review metadata shown to users; it does not gate loading.

changelog.description: Version history, newest first; one short notes string per released version.

deprecation.description: Presence alone means the plugin is deprecated. The Extensions pane warns, stops offering new installs of a deprecated catalogue entry, and points at `replacedBy` when given; already-installed copies keep their existing lifecycle (disable/update/rollback unchanged).

replacedBy.description: Plugin id of the replacement (must differ from this plugin's id).

processCommands.description: Exact executable basenames the extension may invoke. Declarations are review metadata, not enforcement.

networkHosts.description: Network hostnames the extension intends to contact. Declarations are review metadata, not enforcement.

settings.description: Typed extension settings (shell#374). Each declaration drives the generated Control Center settings UI and the PluginKit Settings facade: exact type plus declared constraints are validated on read and write, invalid stored values fall back to `default` (migration), and reset removes the stored value. The type set is closed — boolean, integer, number, string, enum. There is no path type: settings are plain Shell-owned values, never filesystem paths the shell opens. Cross-field rules JSON Schema cannot express (minimum <= maximum, minLength <= maxLength, default inside its range/length, enum default listed in options) are enforced by scripts/validate_plugin.py and mirrored by the runtime (services/Plugins.qml).

actions.description: Optional horneroctl plugin-broker action names (HorneroOS/hornero#408) the extension declares it may request through the typed capability broker (snake_case ids such as system_info or notify). Declarations are review metadata: the broker enforces trust, declaration, typed argv and ABAC at call time, and an undeclared action is refused there. Catalogue membership is enforced by the broker, not by this schema, so the catalogue can grow without a manifest migration.

enabled.description: Whether this surface is enabled by default. A disabled surface is not loaded by its host; other surfaces of the same package are unaffected.

size.description: Dashboard surface only (shell#378): preferred card size class in the composable dashboard layout. A hint the user's persisted layout overrides; declaring it on another surface is rejected by scripts/validate_plugin.py and the runtime host, not by this structural schema.

category.description: Dashboard surface only (shell#378): grouping label under which the dashboard shows this card (uncategorized cards group under Other; "Pinned" is reserved for user-pinned cards). Same enforcement split as `size`.
